text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If I said I had never once felt cursed by it,
well—
that would certainly be an outright lie.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Especially for me last year. You two were...
an exceedingly large source of trouble, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-san and Cesario-san.
Heart-san, too. To me, it's a bit cursed—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And yet...
...My classmates are just too extraordinary."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "And winning the Victoria Mile is Air Messiah! It's Air Messiah! She has magnificently claimed the throne as the Queen of Spring――!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa, whew...! —Aaaaaah~!!
I looooost~...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Messiah-san is just so strong after all...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. The title of Queen was the one thing
I truly didn't want to yield, though!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, I'd like to think I've watched
your hard work from up close, in my own way.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I praise your achievements from the bottom of my heart.
Congratulations, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, as expected.
—You all are truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san. Though they said your form had dipped since
last autumn... to take the stage at such a crucial moment
and display your true strength without faltering is magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not only the nobility befitting a "Queen,"
but the heart to charge ahead, challenging all without fear...
That very spirit must be the brilliance dwelling within you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...Where did this come from all of a sudden?
Hehe, I'm honored, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —And you too, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Starting with the Mile CS after the Shuka Sho,
you charged straight into the sprint circuit in your Senior year...
and showcased such magnificent speed, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Dashing out right from the start, taking the lead, holding on with sheer willpower... and seizing victory.
The way you run is truly the embodiment of who you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The earnest devotion that dwells within you
surely touches the hearts of all who see it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, wh...!?
Th-Thank you...?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Still... mmmgh, I'm happy to hear that, but Messiah-san was the one who won today after all...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "It's frustrating, but! The strongest one among us today was Messiah-san!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I feel proud of that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... you were so strong, so utterly special.
Being able to compete with you all today,
and being able to seize victory—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (It gave me a single, undeniable certainty.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! You really are amazing, Air Messiah-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
"...I haven't gotten your answer yet.
Even so, I... I still want to tell you—!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Regarding our next target race—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Could I please ask you to do it
for the 'Queen Elizabeth II Cup' this fall?
choice_data_list: We're going straight down the royal road of the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
I chose it with that kind of thought in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It may not be particularly bold...
and is perhaps a choice most would expect,
but even so."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why.
...And so, there is something I wish to demonstrate.

"What can Air Messiah carry on?"
When I asked her if she had found the answer to that—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'll sort out my thoughts.
Once I do, please let me talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You're right—come summer, without fail.
